runs.text: The teacher dictates the exam marks one by one. When she finishes, she says -1. The program shows the average of the marks; if she dictated none, it shows

hints.text: Which value warns that the marks are over? Which two things do you need to know to compute an average?
One box for the sum and another for the amount. Before dividing, what happens if the amount is zero?
Read, add and count until -1; then, if the amount is 0 show
and otherwise the sum divided by the amount. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Also show the highest mark. (You will need it in the next lesson.)
case stops with a division by zero. The marks 0 and 0 check that the signal is not confused with a low mark.
